card.title: IPhone XS Max No Touch

claims.statement: iPhone XS Max no touch is most often a top-to-bottom board disconnection (cracked interposer joint or ripped pad); test in iSocket and reball.
Touch supplies (powered, display connected): PN6V7_RACER, PN3V5_RACER, PN10V0_RACER, PN1V8_TOUCH_RACER_S2, PN1V1_RACER, PN5V25_TOUCH_VDDH; most come from U5600 (LM3373A2YKA), shared with iPhone X/XS.
Ripped pads named RACER or Touch must be rebuilt; ground pads can be ignored.

procedure: Test a new display; inspect the touch FPC.
Split; check ripped pads; test in iSocket; reball.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
